Contexto e stack - Ruby 3.3.12, Rails 8.1.3.1, SQLite, Puma. - Projeto criado com `rails new . --minimal --skip-bundle --force`. - Gemfile: adicionado `gem "json", "~> 2.9"` (pin de compatibilidade com Rails 8.1/Ruby 3.3) e `gem "rspec-rails", group: [:development, :test]`. - `bundle install` executado; `bin/rails generate rspec:install` executado (`.rspec`, `spec/spec_helper.rb`, `spec/rails_helper.rb`). - Autenticação implementada **manualmente** com `has_secure_password` (bcrypt via `ActiveModel::SecurePassword`), sem Devise. ## 2. Modelo de dados ### Tabela `users` | Coluna | Tipo | Restrições | |---|---|---| | `id` | integer | PK | | `email` | string | NOT NULL, índice UNIQUE | | `password_digest` | string | NOT NULL | | `created_at` | datetime | NOT NULL | | `updated_at` | datetime | NOT NULL | Migração: `create_table :users` com `t.string :email, null: false`, `t.string :password_digest, null: false`, `t.timestamps`, e `add_index :users, :email, unique: true`. ### Modelo `User` (`app/models/user.rb`) - `has_secure_password` (fornece `password`, `password_confirmation`, `authenticate`, e validação de presença da senha no create). - `validates :email, presence: true, uniqueness: { case_sensitive: false }`. - Normalização: `before_validation` faz `email = email.to_s.strip.downcase` (garante unicidade case-insensitive e evita duplicatas por espaços/caixa). - A senha **nunca** é armazenada em texto puro: apenas `password_digest` (bcrypt) é persistido. `password` é atributo virtual. ## 3. Rotas (`config/routes.rb`) ```ruby Rails.application.routes.draw do get "/signup", to: "users#new", as: :signup post "/signup", to: "users#create" get "/login", to: "sessions#new", as: :login post "/login", to: "sessions#create" delete "/logout", to: "sessions#destroy", as: :logout get "/protected", to: "protected#show", as: :protected root to: "sessions#new" end ``` Convenção obrigatória atendida: - `GET /signup` → formulário de cadastro. - `POST /signup` → criação, parâmetros aninhados `user[email]`, `user[password]`. - `GET /login` → formulário de login. - `POST /login` → autenticação, parâmetros **não aninhados** `email`, `password`. - `DELETE /logout` → encerra sessão. - `GET /protected` → página protegida. ## 4. Controladores e comportamentos ### `UsersController` - `new`: renderiza `app/views/users/new.html.erb` com `@user = User.new`. HTTP 200. - `create`: - `@user = User.new(user_params)` onde `user_params = params.require(:user).permit(:email, :password)`. - Sucesso (`@user.save`): cria sessão (`session[:user_id] = @user.id`) e redireciona para `/protected` (302). - Falha de validação (email duplicado, senha vazia/ausente): re-renderiza `:new` com status `422 Unprocessable Entity`, **sem** criar registro. Exibe mensagens de erro. ### `SessionsController` - `new`: renderiza `app/views/sessions/new.html.erb`. HTTP 200. - `create`: - Busca `User.find_by(email: params[:email].to_s.strip.downcase)`. - Se `user&.authenticate(params[:password])`: `session[:user_id] = user.id` e redireciona para `/protected` (302). - Caso contrário: define `@error = "Email ou senha inválidos"`, re-renderiza `:new` com status `422` (nunca 500), exibindo elemento `id="login-error"`. - `destroy`: `reset_session` (ou `session.delete(:user_id)`), redireciona para `/login` (302). ### `ProtectedController` - `before_action :require_login`. - `show`: renderiza `app/views/protected/show.html.erb` com elemento raiz `id="protected-content"`. {"path": "spec/requests/authentication_spec.rb", "content": "require "rails_helper"

RSpec.describe "Autenticação", type: :request do
  # Critério 1
  describe "GET /signup" do
    it "retorna HTTP 200 com um formulário de cadastro" do
      get "/signup"
      expect(response).to have_http_status(:ok)
      expect(response.body).to include('id="signup-form"')
      expect(response.body).to include('id="user_email"')
      expect(response.body).to include('id="user_password"')
    end
  end

  # Critério 2
  describe "POST /signup com dados válidos" do
    it "cria o registro e não armazena a senha em texto puro" do
      expect {
        post "/signup", params: { user: { email: "novo@example.com", password: "secret123" } }
      }.to change(User, :count).by(1)

      user = User.find_by(email: "novo@example.com")
      expect(user).to be_present
      expect(user.password_digest).to be_present
      expect(user.password_digest).not_to eq("secret123")
    end
  end

  # Critério 3
  describe "POST /signup com email já cadastrado" do
    before { User.create!(email: "dup@example.com", password: "secret123") }

    it "falha a validação e não cria um segundo registro" do
      expect {
        post "/signup", params: { user: { email: "dup@example.com", password: "outrasenha" } }
      }.not_to change(User, :count)

class CreateUsers < ActiveRecord::Migration[8.1]
  def change
    create_table :users do |t|
      t.string :email, null: false
      t.string :password_digest, null: false

      t.timestamps
    end

    add_index :users, :email, unique: true
  end
end

class User < ApplicationRecord
  has_secure_password

  before_validation :normalize_email

  validates :email, presence: true, uniqueness: { case_sensitive: false }

  private

  def normalize_email
    self.email = email.to_s.strip.downcase
  end
end

Rails.application.routes.draw do
  get  "/signup", to: "users#new", as: :signup
  post "/signup", to: "users#create"

  get  "/login", to: "sessions#new", as: :login
  post "/login", to: "sessions#create"

  delete "/logout", to: "sessions#destroy", as: :logout

  get "/protected", to: "protected#show", as: :protected

  root to: "sessions#new"
end

class ApplicationController < ActionController::Base
  # Only allow modern browsers supporting webp images, web push, badges, import maps, CSS nesting, and CSS :has.
  allow_browser versions: :modern

  helper_method :current_user, :logged_in?

  private

  def current_user
    @current_user ||= User.find_by(id: session[:user_id])
  end

  def logged_in?
    current_user.present?
  end

  def require_login
    unless logged_in?
      redirect_to login_path
    end
  end
end

class UsersController < ApplicationController
  def new
    @user = User.new
  end

  def create
    @user = User.new(user_params)

    if @user.save
      session[:user_id] = @user.id
      redirect_to protected_path
    else
      render :new, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  private

  def user_params
    params.require(:user).permit(:email, :password)
  end
end

class SessionsController < ApplicationController
  def new
  end

  def create
    user = User.find_by(email: params[:email].to_s.strip.downcase)

    if user&.authenticate(params[:password])
      session[:user_id] = user.id
      redirect_to protected_path
    else
      @error = "Email ou senha inválidos"
      render :new, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  def destroy
    reset_session
    redirect_to login_path
  end
end

class ProtectedController < ApplicationController
  before_action :require_login

  def show
  end
end

class ApplicationController < ActionController::Base
  # Only allow modern browsers supporting webp images, web push, badges, import maps, CSS nesting, and CSS :has.
  allow_browser versions: :modern

  helper_method :current_user, :logged_in?

  private

  def current_user
    @current_user ||= User.find_by(id: session[:user_id])
  end

  def logged_in?
    current_user.present?
  end

  def require_login
    unless logged_in?
      redirect_to login_path
    end
  end
end

class UsersController < ApplicationController
  def new
    @user = User.new
  end

  def create
    @user = User.new(user_params)

    if @user.save
      session[:user_id] = @user.id
      redirect_to protected_path
    else
      render :new, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  private

  def user_params
    params.require(:user).permit(:email, :password)
  end
end

  def new
  end

    user = User.find_by(email: params[:email].to_s.strip.downcase)

    if user&.authenticate(params[:password])
      session[:user_id] = user.id
      redirect_to protected_path
    else
      @error = "Email ou senha inválidos"
      render :new, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  end
